title: Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1 Explained with Football Data
description:
Accuracy, precision, recall, specificity and the F1 score explained with football data: the numbers that summarize a confusion matrix.
We compute each of them from the four cells, add balanced accuracy, and see why accuracy can mislead when a class is rare.

Chapters
0:00 Six players and their confusion matrix
2:15 Accuracy and error rate
2:54 Precision, recall and specificity
4:12 F1 score and balanced accuracy
5:21 A lower threshold changes the numbers
7:52 All players, and the base rate
